Balaji Amines Limited is a prominent Indian chemical manufacturing company headquartered at 165-A, Railway Lines, Solapur – 413001, Maharashtra, India. Established with a focus on producing specialty chemicals, the company has grown into one of India’s leading manufacturers of aliphatic amines, amine derivatives, and other value-added chemical products. Over the years, Balaji Amines has built a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and innovation, serving a wide range of industries including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, water treatment, rubber chemicals, dyes, paints, resins, oil and gas, and personal care products.

The company’s product portfolio includes methylamines, ethylamines, dimethylformamide, dimethylacetamide, acetonitrile, morpholine, piperidine, and several other specialty and derivative chemicals. These products are widely used as intermediates in the production of medicines, crop protection chemicals, solvents, and industrial formulations. Balaji Amines has developed advanced manufacturing capabilities supported by modern infrastructure, research and development initiatives, and a strong focus on process efficiency.

With manufacturing facilities located in Maharashtra and other strategic industrial areas, Balaji Amines Limited has strengthened its presence in both domestic and international markets. The company places significant emphasis on quality control, environmental responsibility, workplace safety, and customer satisfaction. Its consistent growth reflects its commitment to meeting the evolving needs of the chemical industry while maintaining high standards of operational excellence.

Today, Balaji Amines Limited stands as a respected name in India’s specialty chemical sector, contributing to the country’s industrial development and supporting key downstream industries through its diverse range of chemical products.
